symptom: check-syntax skill told agents every forward reference fails, a month after #1179 made plain exec resolve forward flow calls; the fix had been deferred because the skill was at the 700-line body limit
cause: a behaviour change edited resolve-forward-references but not the second skill restating the same rule, and the line limit made the edit look expensive
insight: Measure the skill limit with the test, not wc: TestLargeSkillsWereSplit excludes the generated skill-index block, so the 714-line file was 694 lines of body and the issue's 'over the limit' was already false; the correction itself pushed it to 703, so the split was still needed. Before writing a behaviour claim into a skill, run it — `check` flags a forward enumeration (MDL-ORDER01) but not a forward snippetcall, which the first draft over-claimed.
